evidence.quote: At the Fed, we have identified efficiency and safety as our most fundamental objectives, as set forth in our Policy on Payment System Risk.
Today, however, I will focus on the Faster Payments Task Force.
My last topic is the potential use of DLT or other technologies by central banks to issue a digital currency to the general public.
